d: A small humanoid with pale lavender hair, styled with blunt bangs and a short bob, paired with narrow, piercing lime-green eyes. The figure appears to be a young adolescent with a slight, slender build, wearing a white fabric wrap as a headband, a grey face mask covering the nose and mouth, and a white sleeveless tunic with matching white leg wraps and boots. This figure is cradled by a massive, armored entity with dark grey skin, giant clawed hands, and a deep navy blue hooded cloak, featuring several large, curved black horns with lime-green tips protruding from the shoulders and head. BODY COLOR: pale grey and deep navy LEGS: plantigrade with small, wrapped feet.
